backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Media Share backend, defining data types and logic for videos, photos, comments, likes, user profiles, channels, and ratings, with access control enforced via a mixin authorization system.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report identifying the VideoPlayer.tsx file as the location of the view count increment bug fix, with high confidence and a single test requirement.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key behaviors of each component, page, and hook.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Media Share frontend, setting metadata, favicon links, and mounting the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines all TanStack Router routes for the application, including pages for home, video/photo gallery, upload, player, viewer, settings, channel profile, upgrade, shorts, subscriptions, and profile.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a future Add to Playlist modal component.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Thin wrapper component that renders the ProfileDropdownMenu for placement in the app header.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with links to Home, Upload, Shorts, and Subscriptions, plus a Profile tab that opens the ProfileDropdownMenu dropdown instead of navigating.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Component that fetches and displays a user's channel name as a clickable link to their channel profile, showing a skeleton loader while fetching and truncating the principal string if no custom name is set.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment section for a video, allowing authenticated users to post comments and displaying existing comments with author avatars, channel names, and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistMo: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/DeleteVideoButto: Renders a delete button that triggers a confirmation AlertDialog before permanently deleting a video via the useDeleteVideo hook.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component providing a sticky header with search, upload, and auth controls, a collapsible sidebar, bottom navigation, and a footer with social links.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Displays a photo thumbnail card with title, uploader channel name, and upload date, navigating to the photo detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ProfileDropdownM: Dropdown menu for profile management supporting multi-account switching, sign-in, sign-out, and navigation to profile/settings, with display name synced from the user profile.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users without a profile to enter a name and optional channel name, saving the profile via useSaveCallerUserProfile.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Button that copies the current page URL to the clipboard and shows a toast notification on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Collapsible sidebar with Home, Trending, and Library navigation links, supporting a mobile overlay and smooth slide-in/out transition.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: A controlled tag input component that allows users to add tags by pressing Enter or comma and remove them by clicking X, rendering each tag as a Badge.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: A component that auto-generates thumbnail candidates from video frames at multiple positions and allows users to select one or upload a custom JPEG/PNG thumbnail with size/format validation.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: Displays a premium upgrade prompt card with feature highlights only to free-tier users, hiding itself for premium users or while loading subscription status.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders a clickable video card in either default or compact layout, showing the thumbnail, title, uploader channel name, view count, and relative upload time.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: A dialog modal with Details and Thumbnail tabs for editing a video's title, description, tags, and thumbnail, using separate hooks for updating metadata and removing thumbnails.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: A dropdown UI component for selecting video playback quality (auto, 360p–1080p) with a note that actual quality depends on browser and source capabilities.
frontend/src/components/VideoRating.tsx: An interactive 5-star rating component that shows the user's current rating with hover effects and submits ratings via the useRateVideo hook, requiring authentication.
frontend/src/components/VideoRatingDispl: Displays the average star rating for a video using full, half, and empty star icons along with the total rating count fetched from dedicated hooks.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: React component for managing video thumbnail settings, allowing users to view, change, or remove the current thumbnail via ThumbnailSelector.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both authenticated and anonymous identities, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook that calls the backend to add a comment to a video and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAverageRating.ts: Query hook that fetches the average rating for a given video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that retrieves a channel name for a given principal, caching the result for 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches the list of comments for a given video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteVideo.ts: Mutation hook that deletes a video by ID via the backend actor and invalidates video-related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile from the backend, with loading state tied to actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserRating.ts: Query hook that retrieves the authenticated user's rating for a specific video by searching their ratings list.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: Query hook that returns the user's subscription status; currently hardcoded to return a free tier until backend integration is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: Mutation hook that increments the view count for a video and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: Mutation hook that marks a video thumbnail as generated on the backend and invalidates video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useMultiAccount.ts: Hook that manages multiple stored ICP accounts in localStorage, supporting adding, removing, and switching accounts with identity and query cache management.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: Query hook that fetches the list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a photo file with title and description to the backend, tracking upload progress and invalidating the photos query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that submits a star rating for a video via the actor and invalidates all related rating and video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: Mutation hook that removes a video's thumbnail via the actor and invalidates the relevant video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Mutation hook that saves the current user's profile via the actor and invalidates user profile and channel name queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: Query hook that searches videos by a search term using the actor, fetching full video data for each result.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: Mutation hook that validates and sets the caller's channel name via the actor, invalidating channel name and user profile queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: Mutation hook that uploads a custom thumbnail for a video with progress tracking, invalidating related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: Mutation hook placeholder for subscribing to a channel; currently always throws an error indicating the feature is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: Query hook placeholder that returns false for subscription status, as the backend subscription feature is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useTotalRatings.ts: Query hook that fetches the total number of ratings for a given video via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that updates a video's title, description, and tags via the actor and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: Mutation hook placeholder for upgrading a user account; currently always throws an error as the backend implementation is pending.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Query hook that fetches user statistics for a given principal via the actor, caching results for 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: Query hook that fetches extended video data for a given video ID via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: Mutation hook that likes a video via the actor and invalidates the videos list and individual video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: Query hook that fetches the list of all video metadata via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a video file with progress tracking, converting it to an ExternalBlob and calling the backend actor, with typed error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Displays a public channel profile page showing a user's videos and photos, with edit/delete actions visible to the channel owner. Fetches channel name, stats, videos, and photos using principal-based hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that fetches and displays all videos sorted by upload time (newest first) in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo gallery page that lists all photos in a grid with debounced search filtering by title and description.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Full-page viewer for a single photo that converts raw binary data to a blob URL for display, showing title, uploader, date, and description.
frontend/src/pages/PlaylistDetail.tsx: Empty file with no content implemented yet.
frontend/src/pages/Playlists.tsx: Empty file with no content implemented yet.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Authenticated user's own profile page showing their uploaded videos and photos with edit/delete actions, plus stats like view and like counts.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing authenticated users to update their display name and channel name, and view their subscription tier status.
frontend/src/pages/Shorts.tsx: Placeholder page for a short-form video feature that is not yet implemented, displaying a 'Coming Soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/Subscriptions.tsx: Placeholder subscriptions page showing a 'Coming Soon' message for authenticated users, or a prompt to browse channels for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Displays a subscription upgrade page with Free and Premium tier cards, showing current plan status and allowing authenticated users to upgrade their account via the useUpgradeAccount hook.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Provides a photo upload form with title, description, and file input fields, showing a preview and upload progress, then navigating to the photos gallery on success.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Handles video file upload with validation (format and 500MB size limit), title/description/tags input, and post-upload thumbnail selection, invalidating the videos query cache on success.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Renders a searchable grid of video cards using debounced search input, switching between all videos and search results from their respective hooks.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Full video player page that tracks 5 seconds of real watch time before incrementing view count, and supports liking, subscribing, editing, deleting, rating, sharing, and displaying related videos and comments.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Exports two utility functions: formatViewCount converts a BigInt view count to a human-readable string (K/M/B), and formatTimeAgo converts a nanosecond BigInt timestamp to a relative time string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, font family, and animation keyframes for the frontend.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking the current fix request to resolve unreliable view count incrementation in the VideoPlayer page.
